gap: AU2 G17: lifetime caps counted across the runtime
works: Upload caps count only open receipts and the bytes they reserve; finished, aborted and expired receipts free their slot. A case keeps its own retained-bytes ceiling. Streaming import history is bounded per case, not per runtime. Every 429 names its limit and when a slot frees.

limits.openReceipts: Same numbers as before: large-original/1 at most 4 open on the service, 2 per operator subject, 2 per case; large-original/2 at most 1 open. Open = receiving, finalizing or aborting, and before expiry, under a live worker lease, or (v2, not receiving) with a storage job queued to finish it.
limits.openBytes: Bytes reserved by open receipts runtime-wide <= maxReservedOriginalBytes (512 MiB v1, 7 GiB v2). Per operator subject shares the same number, so the runtime-wide sum bounds both.
limits.retainedPerCase: D2: retained plus open originals of the request's profile in the case, plus the request, <= maxReservedOriginalBytes of that profile (512 MiB v1, 7 GiB v2): the reserved-original limit the contract already stated.
limits.configuredStorage: When ULPIN_LARGE_ORIGINAL_V2_CAPACITY_BYTES is set: retained originals once + leftover bytes of receipts without a slot (their parts until cleanup, and an original a failed finalization may have assembled) + 2x open v1 + 3x open v2 + the request at its factor. Before it tripled every original ever reserved, retained ones included.
limits.removed: maxUploadReceipts (128 v1, 8 v2 ever) from LARGE_ORIGINAL_LIMITS and LARGE_ORIGINAL_V2_LIMITS; regenerated docs/api/openapi.json, source-pins.json and packages/api-client schema.d.ts.
limits.streaming: STREAMING_HISTORY_CAPACITY: 128 imports per case (operations primary key starts with case_id). The large GeoJSON intake path (intake-large-worker.ts) enqueues through this reader, so it did spend the runtime-wide 128, which settles the gap's open note. 2 running imports unchanged.

expiry: D3: nothing sweeps expired receipts (no reader of usp_source_uploads.expires_at outside large-original.ts), so the check skips them; their leftover part bytes still count against configured storage.

refusal.code: UPLOAD_QUOTA (unchanged; intake-zip-layers.ts reads only the code)
refusal.details: {limit: open_receipts | open_receipts_operator | open_receipts_case | open_bytes | case_retained_bytes | storage_capacity, freesAt: ISO time of the earliest expiry of an open receipt in that scope, or null}
refusal.words: Limit numbers only, in MiB/GiB; no filename, hash or size of the file.
refusal.bugFound: A 7 GiB ceiling written as 7516192768 bytes is masked as [redacted phone] by redactDerivative in the 429 body; sizes are now words and a regression test checks it.
